Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from the first ODI of this series. New Zealand go 1-0 up and will be eyeing a series win in the second ODI. Netherlands, on the other hand, need to bring their A-game on the table if they want to level the series in the next game. The second ODI starts at 6.30 am IST (1.00 am GMT) on Saturday, 2nd April. Our coverage, as you know, will start in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers.

Pieter Seelaar, the Netherlands skipper, says the spinners bowled quite well and they hanged in there and tried till the end. Adds that the wicket was nice to bat on and they feel like 260 would have been better but tells that it was quite nice to bat out there. Tells that the players were tentative but now they need to shake things off and play better at Hamilton.

Tom Latham, the skipper of New Zealand, says that they want to win every game and adds that boys bowled well after losing the toss and says that it is a clinical finish with the bat as well. He mentions that Blair Tickner was quite good with the ball on his debut and brought great energy and also applauds Young for this knock and its free flowing nature. Tells that though lot of guys are missing there is quite a bit of experience in the dressing room and it is an opportunity for guys to step up.

Will Young is the Player of the Match. Says he is over the moon to score a century for his country. Adds the team is run smoothly by the management and they have to worry about cricket mostly. Tells that it is about taking the opportunity when it comes. About Blair Tickner, he says they had a word early in the morning and both had a great game. Mentions that he has played ODI cricket at no. 3 so he got a chance and he knocked off.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

Well, Netherlands have a lot to ponder about their performance tonight. Michael Rippon and Pieter Seelaar were the only two who showed some fight with the bat while the bowlers too lacked penetration to trouble Kiwi batters. Michael Rippon was the man again who gave Netherlands something to cheer about as he knocked down Henry Nicholls and Ross Taylor with his crafty spin bowling. However, it was little too late and the game was out of their reach till then. Dutch need their top-order to fire as the conditions will most probably remain batting friendly and unless the batters come to the party, it is very hard for Netherlands to get a positive result along the way.

New Zealand suffered an early blow in the chase as Netherlands bowlers got good swing in the initial overs. However, the moment Will Young walked out in the middle, he was at his fluent best. He kept the scoring-rate going and soon Henry Nicholls also found his touch and both of them just kept playing risk-free cricket without much fuss. Young notched up his maiden ODI century on the way as he mixed caution with aggression to a great effect while Henry Nicholls departed after a well-compiled fifty. However, the only disappointment for New Zealand fans will be that Ross Taylor could not finish off the game but overall a very fine performance from the Blackcaps.

A comfortable victory for the Kiwis despite a valiant effort by Michael Rippon both with the bat and ball. The victory though was always on cards, when they restricted Netherlands to 45-5 with the ball and though Netherlands managed to get to a decent score in the end, it was never going to be enough against a strong Kiwi batting lineup.

FOUR! Century for Will Young! A full ball, on  off. Young comes down the track and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary. What a superb innings this is from Young. He guided the chase from almost the start and took his team over the line. New Zealand win by 7 wickets.
Shorter and on off. Young punches it through point for a couple of runs.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
A loopy ball, on off. Young skips down and tucks it straight to mid-wicket. New Zealand one big hit away.
Shorter and on off. Latham slaps it to covers for a single.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
Flatter and on off, pushed to point.
Tossed up, on middle. Young reverse sweeps it through short third man for a single.
A quicker arm ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Full, slower and on middle. Latham paddles it to fine leg for a couple of runs. New Zealand are just 8 runs away.
On off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Young skips down and lofts it high in the air and to long on where the ball drops safely. The long off fielder comes across and cuts it off. Two taken.
a loopy ball, on middle. Latham again comes down and pushes it uppishly but wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Latham skips down and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a barce.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
Slightly short and on middle. Latham pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Another solid block from Latham.
Tossed up, on the pads. Blocked out.

OUT! BOWLED! Through the gate, superb bowling from Michael Rippon! This is tossed up, outside off, this one lands and spins back in sharply. Ross Taylor looks to drive but leaves a big gap and the ball goes through the gate and hits the stumps. Is there something special there for Netherlands?
Shorter and outside off, angling back in. Taylor looks to cut it but misses.
Full ball, outside off. Ross drives it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
On the shorter side and outside off. Taylor cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Goes quicker and flatter outside off. Taylor slaps it to point.
On the shorter side and turning away slightly from off. Young goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Slower in the air, around off. Young sweeps it to short fine leg.
Short and wide outside off. Taylor goes back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Taylor blocks it out.

Another appeal but a very optimistic one! This one is tossed up, around off. Young skips down the track and looks to defend. He misses as the ball hits his pads. There is an appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Drinks! Netherlands have tightened things up in past couple of overs but it seems too late for them. Just 22 runs are needed and New Zealand should win this easily.
A flatter delivery and slightly shorter on off. Young looks to pull it but mistimes it.
A fuller delivery on middle. Taylor works it to mid-wicket for a single.

Ross Taylor will continue as Netherlands lose their review! This is tossed up, around off. Taylor presses forward to defend but misses it as the ball turns into the batter. The ball brushes his pads and goes to the keeper. He takes a catch and Netherlands players appeal. The umpire though is not interested and the UltraEdge shows that the ball has hit the pad. So Ross Taylor will continue.
A fuller delivery on middle. Taylor works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Slightly short and bit of width provided. Taylor goes back and cuts it hard. The ball goes off the thick outside edge through backward point for a boundary.
A fuller delivery, outside off and turning away. Young leaves it alone.
Short and wide outside off. Taylor cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Taylor drives it to mid off.
This is slower in the air and outside off. Taylor leaves it alone.
A flatter delivery on off. Taylor blocks it out.
Tossed up on off. Taylor drives it to covers.
Flatter and on off. Young hits it to point.
Flatter and on off, Taylor punches it to long off to get off the mark with a single.
Ross Taylor is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Finally a wicket for Netherlands but it is little too late. This is pushed quicker on off. Henry Nicholls looks to late cut it but the ball sneaks past his blade to knock over the stumps. End of a good innings by Henry Nicholls but Michael Rippon does the trick with the ball now, all credit to the fight he is putting.
Tossed up on middle. Young works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Young looks to defend but the ball turns and sneaks between his bat and pad. The keeper misses it too and the batters run two bye.
A fuller delivery on middle. Young works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls works it to square leg.
Slower in the air on middle. Henry Nicholls looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Pitches on middle and leg and it turns further down the leg side. Henry Nicholls looks to reverse-sweep but misses. The keeper misses too and two byes are taken behind the keeper.
Darted on leg. Henry Nicholls tucks it to short fine leg.
Flatter on middle. Henry Nicholls works it towards deep square leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Young skips down the track and pushes it to long off for a single.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Young looks to reverse sweep it but misses completely.
This one lands on middle and turns into the batter. Young looks to sweep it but misses. An appeal for LBW but not given.
Floated, on a length and on off, was slower in the air. Young blocks it back to Rippon.
Tossed up, on off. Young slams it through covers for a brace.
Tad short and on off. Young looks to pull but miscues it to Rippon.
Michael Rippon is back on. He has gone for 17 runs in his three overs.
A single to end the over as this full ball is pushed through covers.
Tossed up, on off. Will defends it under his eyes.
On middle. Kept out.
An arm ball, fuller and on off. Young pushes it back to Seelaar.
Flatter and on off. Nicholls chips it to long on for a single.
Very full, quicker and on middle. Nicholls smashes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Wide! Fifth extra of the over! Changes the angle as he comes over the wicket but still serve it down the leg side.
Full ball, on middle, pushed back past the bowler for a single.
Wide! Glover is not finding his rhythm! Another one down the leg side for the fourth wide of the over.
Wide! Again! Full, down the leg side. Another wide.
Wide! Too many extras from Netherlands! A full ball, down the leg side. Nicholls swings and misses.
Length ball, outside off. Young dabs it to third man for a single.
Length ball, outside off and nipping away off the deck. Young looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Need to bowl more in the same area.
Length ball, on middle. Nicholls pulls it square on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Overpitched down the leg side. Nicholls misses his flick.
This is full and on the pads. Nicholls misses his heave.
Very full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Wide! Shorter, outside off, turning further away. Left alone.
SIX! This time the result is even better! Another full toss, on off. Young hammers it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Floated, on off. Blocked out.
On middle, this is worked to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Young punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! You don't need a second invitation for these deliveries! A friendly full toss, on off. Young pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Nicholls flicks it to the right of mid-wicket. Good fielding there. 5 runs off the over.
Width given outside off. Young slaps it to deep cover for a run.
Short of a length, on off. Nicholls pulls it to deep square leg for one more.
Length and on off. Young strokes it through covers for a single.
Angles it on the hips, this is flicked to deep square leg for one more. That brings up the fifty for Henry Nicholls! Good start to the series for him.
Short in length and angling on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter on middle. Henry Nicholls pulls it to deep square leg for a couple. 12 runs from the over!
A full toss on off. Young punches it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This time a boundary. Uses his feet again and gets to the pitch of the ball. It is on middle and he lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on off. Young paddle-sweeps it to fine leg for a couple.
Tossed up on middle. Young shimmies down the track and hits it down the ground. Vikramjit Singh runs to his right from long off and stops it with a dive. Two runs taken.
On middle. Henry Nicholls skips down the track and takes it on full. He hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Henry Nicholls pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single. Just 80 needed now.
On a length, around off. Young makes room and steers it towards third man for a single.
Hits the length hard, on off. Young dabs it towards the off side.
Back of a length, on middle. Henry Nicholls pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs it short on off. Young pulls it aerially and short of deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Young works it to mid-wicket.

Nicely bowled! A fuller delivery on off, good loop on this one. Henry Nicholls drives it to covers.
Straight as an arrow! A full delivery on off. Henry Nicholls takes it on full and smashes this at the stumps on the bowler's end.
Quicker and fuller on off. Henry Nicholls drives it to mid off.
A flatter delivery on middle. Young works it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off. Young chops it to backward point.
Tossed up, outside off. Young drives it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
Philippe Boissevain is into the attack now.
Hits the length hard again, on middle. Henry Nicholls works it to mid-wicket.
Serves a length delivery, around off. Henry Nicholls square drives it past point and comes back for a couple.
On the shorter side, on middle and leg. Henry Nicholls pulls it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Lands on a length, on off. Henry Nicholls blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Young dabs it towards backward point. There is a direct hit at the batter's end but a single is completed comfortably. 100 partnership up.
Fred Klaassen bangs it short on off. Young ducks under it.
Tossed up delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls works it towards the leg side.

Goes fuller on off. Young sweeps it but fails to get any timing again.
A fuller delivery on middle. Young sweeps but finds the fielder at square leg.
A flatter delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls works it behind square on the leg side for a single.

Direct hit and it would have been very close! A fuller delivery on off. Young skips down the track and pushes it to mid off and sets off for a single. Bas de Leede runs to his right and slides and throws it quickly at the bowler's end, misses.  A single taken.
On a length, outside off. Young plays it very late and the ball bounces over the keeper to short third man. The batters take a single.
On a driving length, outside off. Young square drives it to deep point for a couple of runs.
Short in length, on middle. Nicholls pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle. Young hits it to mid-wicket for a single.

Full, straight on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.

Fifty for Will Young! Fuller ball, on off. Young pushes it to long off for a single. He elevates his bat and soaks the applause from his team. His maiden ODI fifty.

Tossed up, on middle. Young dances down and drills it to mid-wicket.
Darted on the pads. Nicholls hits it to mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
A flighted ball, on middle. Young chips it to mid on for a single.
Flatter, quicker and around off. Young rocks back and pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! Cleared the fence with ease! This is full and on off. Young skips down and lofts it nicely over long off for a biggie.
On middle, swept in front of square on the leg side for a run.
On the pads, fuller and Young glances it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on off, swept to fine leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to point.

Drinks! This has been a good steady start from New Zealand. They lost an early wicket of Martin Guptill but since then, Henry Nicholls and Will Young have played pretty well to take them to the safer shores. Netherlands bowlers got some swing early on but failed to put pressure on a consistent basis on the batters. The target is not a big one and they need to take wickets quickly here to put some pressure on New Zealand.
Fuller and on middle. Young mistimes his reverse sweep to covers.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one more.
Fuller and on off, Young leans and pushes it through covers for a single.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A quicker ball, fuller and on middle. Nicholls nudges it to square leg.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Keeps it full and on middle. Young works it to mid-wicket but cannot find the gap.
Flighted, full and on off, pushed back to the left of Rippon.
On middle, eased down to long on for one.
Tossed up, down the leg side. Young sweeps it to fine leg. The fielder runs to his left, dives and does well to save a single. Some effort there.
Rippon angles it on a fuller-length, this one holds it line. Nicholls sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
This time a bit quicker and fuller on middle. Henry Nicholls flicks it to mid-wicket.
A flatter delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls works it towards mid-wicket.
Slower in the air on off and turning in. Henry Nicholls defends it off the front foot.
Goes fuller on off. Young drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery and shorter on middle. Henry Nicholls goes deep in his crease and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on off. Henry Nicholls works it to mid-wicket.

A flatter delivery on off. Young goes back and punches it to mid on.

Slower in the air, on off. Young blocks it off the front foot.
Short and wide outside off. Henry Nicholls cuts it to deep point for a single.

Michael Rippon to bowl now.
Goes fuller on middle. Henry Nicholls drives it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Henry Nicholls blocks it out.
On middle and turning into the batter. Henry Nicholls looks to work it towards the leg side but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter on middle. Henry Nicholls blocks it out.
Goes fuller on off. Young drives it to long off for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Young blocks it out.
Lands on a length and outside off. Young cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length and outside off. Young leaves it alone.
WIDE! Another fullish delivery and wider outside off. Left alone.
WIDE! This is full and way too wide outside off. Young leaves it alone.
Goes fuller on middle. Young drives it to mid on.
Back of a length, on middle. Young defends it towards the leg side.
Lands on a length, on middle. Henry Nicholls clips it to square leg for a single.
WIDE! On a length and angling down the leg side. Henry Nicholls looks to clip it but misses.

Another short ball angling into the body from 'round the wicket. Henry Nicholls pulls but it goes off the top edge towards deep backward square leg. The ball falls short of the fielder in the deep and he misfields a bit. Other fielder cuts it off and two runs are taken.

Lands on a length angling into off. Henry Nicholls defends it onto the turf.
Pitches this one up, on middle. Henry Nicholls drives it to mid on.

This is full and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Glorious drive! A full toss, on middle. Nicholls pushes with soft hands but bisects the mid on and mid off fielder with ease to find himself a boundary.

FOUR!  Will Young is dealing in boundaries! Shorter in length and on middle. Young pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very full and on middle. Young digs it out back to Leede.
On middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! Three in a row! Will Young is taking on Logan van Beek! Short of a length, on middle. Will Young pulls it along the ground and to deep square leg for a boundary.

Length ball, just outside off. Young guides it to point.
Length and outside off. Nicholls cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Nicholls misses his flick.
Short in length and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for one.
Another solid defense from Young as he keeps this one out on the off side.
Straight on middle, on a length. Young brings straight bat down to defend.
Length ball, on off. Nicholls bunts it mid-wicket for a quick single.
Length ball, around off. Young leans and defends it out.
Slightly short and on middle. Blocked out.
Angles on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off. Young plays it late and with soft hands to the slip cordon.
SIX! Pulled away! Short ball, on middle. Young is in full control as he pulls this one over square leg for a biggie.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Logan van Beek gets the first breakthrough and it is a big wicket of Martin Guptill! They needed early wicket and have got one now. A good-length delivery, around off. Martin Guptill takes a step or two forward and looks to go big downtown. However, the ball nips away a bit and catches the outside edge of the blade. Scott Edwards takes a catch behind the stumps and Martin Guptill walks back disappointed.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Bit of mix-up between the batters, no damage done. A good-length delivery, around off. Henry Nicholls pushes it towards backward point and looks for a single. Guptill also responds but is sent back by his partner at the right time.
Effort ball this time. A short ball, around off. Henry Nicholls sways away from the line of the ball.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is full on leg. Henry Nicholls clips it fine towards the long leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length again, outside off. Henry Nicholls punches it to point off the back foot.
Back of a length, around off. Martin Guptill punches it to deep cover-point for a single.
Pitched fuller on middle. Martin Guptill  drives it to mid on.
Goes fuller on off. Henry Nicholls drives it to mid off. Bit of swing on offer for both the opening bowlers but they need to get their lines and lengths right.
Back of a length, on off. Henry Nicholls blocks it onto the turf.
FOUR LEG BYES! Drifts around leg. Henry Nicholls looks to clip it but misses. The ball brushes his thigh pads and goes away for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off and shaping away. Henry Nicholls leaves it alone.
Short and wide outside off. Martin Guptill cuts it aerially and short of third man for a single.
WIDE! Logan van Beek goes short on off. It is a bit too high and Martin Guptill leaves it alone. The umpire calls it wide.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Hint of away swing there. Martin Guptill leaves it alone.
Who will start from the other end? It is Logan van Beek.

Ohh..steep bounce this time! Goes short, around off. Martin Guptill sways away from the line of the ball. The keeper jumps to stop it. He gets a finger on it and half-stops it. The ball goes behind him and a bye is taken. New Zealand are underway.
Back of a length and close to off. Martin Guptill rides the bounce and blocks it.
Serves it on a length, on off. Martin Guptill blocks it off the front foot.
Goes fuller on off and again that shape into the batter. Martin Guptill drives it off the inside half of his blade to mid on.
Starts with a good-length delivery on middle and a bit of shape into Martin Guptill. He defends it towards the leg side.
